item.title: Ahn Cheol-soo: "Even President Lee's home had insufficient loans, leading to a mortgage... Ease the total loan ceiling" (안철수 “李대통령 집도 대출 모자라 근저당… 대출 총량제 풀어라”)
item.description:
Ahn Cheol-soo: "Even President Lee's home had insufficient loans, leading to a mortgage... Ease the total loan ceiling" (안철수 “李대통령 집도 대출 모자라 근저당… 대출 총량제 풀어라”)

Ahn Cheol-soo, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, criticized the government's real estate policies, which focus on loan regulations, on the 27th, arguing that "the total loan ceiling must be eased first." (안철수 국민의힘 의원이 27일 대출 규제 위주인 정부의 부동산 대책을 비판하면서 “대출 총량제부터 풀어야 한다”고 주장했다.)

In a Facebook post that morning, Ahn stated, "Today, another real estate debate will be held under the prime minister's chairmanship," adding, "It will be a re-screening of a sadistic play that pours out ways to torment homeowners and actual buyers with taxes and regulations." (안 의원은 이날 아침 페이스북에 글을 올려 “오늘은 총리 주재로 또 부동산 대토론회가 열린다”며 “집주인과 실수요자를 세금과 규제로 괴롭힐 방법을 쏟아내는 가학극이 재상영될 것”이라고 했다.)

Ahn claimed, "The core of the real estate issue is loans," saying, "It's not that people can't buy homes because there are none, but that they can't buy even if they want to because they can't get loans." He added, "It's telling that 95% of the financial petitions at the last real estate debate were for loan easing." (안 의원은 “부동산 문제의 핵심은 대출”이라며 “집이 없어서 못 사는 게 아니라, 사고 싶어도 대출을 받지 못해 못 사는 게 현실”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “오죽하면 지난번 부동산 대토론회 금융 청원의 95%가 대출 완화였겠느냐”고 했다.)

He pointed out, "Even though people can afford to repay principal and interest according to their means, the Lee Jae-myung administration has blocked housing loans with strong regulations," and noted, "Now, only those with cash, recipients of semiconductor performance bonuses, or employees at large corporations with billion-won internal loans can buy homes." He also criticized, "By preventing housing loans, the government and banks have caused a balloon effect, leading to an explosion in credit and overdraft 'investment through borrowing.'" (그는 “형편에 맞게 원리금을 갚아 나갈 수 있음에도 이재명 정부는 강력한 규제로 주택 대출을 차단했다”며 “집은 이제 현금 보유자, 반도체 성과급 수령자, 억대 사내 대출의 대기업 직원만 살 수 있게 됐다”고 짚었다. “이 정부와 은행이 주택 대출을 막으니 풍선 효과로 신용·마통(마이너스 통장) ‘빚투(빚내서 투자)’가 폭발했다”고도 지적했다.)

Ahn sharply remarked, "Even President Lee's 2.9 billion won apartment only got a 200 million won loan, so in the end, didn't he have to secure 1.77 billion won with a mortgage?" (안 의원은 “이 대통령의 29억 아파트도 대출이 2억밖에 나오지 않으니, 결국 17.7억을 근저당으로 잡지 않았느냐”고 꼬집었다.)

He said, "Meanwhile, KB has halved its mortgage loan limits, and Shinhan Bank has also reduced its credit loan limits," adding, "Our people will now face a 'loan moratorium.' The gap between those who have received loans and those who haven't will widen even further." (그는 “이 와중에 KB는 주담대(주택담보대출) 한도를 반토막 냈고, 신한은행도 신용대출 한도를 줄였다”며 “이제 우리 국민은 ‘대출 모라토리엄’에 직면할 것이다. 대출받은 국민과 못 받는 사람의 격차는 더 커질 것이다”라고 했다.)

Regarding solutions, Ahn argued, "This government must immediately ease the target for total loan ceiling management," insisting, "Mortgage loan limits should be increased by more than double, and the LTV (Loan-to-Value ratio) limit for actual buyers should also be significantly raised." (해법과 관련해 안 의원은 “이 정부는 즉시 대출 총량 관리 목표치를 완화해야 한다”며 “주담대 한도는 2배 이상 늘리고, 실수요자의 LTV(주택 가격 대비 담보대출 비율) (제한 상한도) 크게 높여야 한다”고 주장했다.)

Ahn stated, "The logical order is for finance to accompany demand, so how long will we just keep repeating vague promises of supply?" and said, "Even if 10 million homes are supplied in Seoul, people can't buy them without loans." He concluded, "The most urgently needed policy now is 'shut up and lend.' I hope it is remembered that loans are a fundamental minimum right for pursuing economic freedom and happiness." (안 의원은 “수요에 맞게 금융이 동반되는 게 순서이지, 언제까지 기약 없는 공급 타령만 할 것이냐”며 “서울에 1000만호를 공급한들 대출이 없으면 못 산다”고 했다. 그러면서 “지금 가장 필요한 정책은 ‘닥치고 대출’이다. 대출이야말로 경제적 자유와 행복 추구를 위한 최소한의 기본권임을 명심하기 바란다”고 했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "Continue Maximum Oil Price System Until Oil Price Instability is Resolved" (李대통령 “유가불안 해소때까지 석유 최고가격제 계속”)
item.description:
President Lee: "Continue Maximum Oil Price System Until Oil Price Instability is Resolved" (李대통령 “유가불안 해소때까지 석유 최고가격제 계속”)

<<>> President Lee Jae-myung, who is on a state visit to Brazil, mentioned on the 26th (local time) the ongoing war between the U.S. and Iran, stating, "I ask that the maximum oil price system be maintained until oil price instability is clearly resolved, and that policy measures such as fuel tax cuts be kept in place as much as possible." ()

During a meeting with senior secretaries held in Brasília, the capital of Brazil, the President said, "Given that oil price volatility is likely to persist for the time being, we must quickly make preemptive efforts to minimize its impact on domestic prices, and if the situation worsens, we should actively consider additional measures," adding the above remarks. (브라질을 국빈 방문 중인 이재명 대통령은 26일(현지 시각) 미국과 이란의 전쟁이 계속되는 점을 언급하며 “유가 불안이 확실하게 해소되는 시점까지 석유 최고 가격제를 지속하고, 유류세 인하 같은 정책 수단도 최대한 유지해 주기 바란다”고 말했다.)

The meeting was conducted via video conference, connecting online with the South Korean presidential office, Cheong Wa Dae. This marks the second time President Lee has held a video meeting with senior secretaries while abroad on a state visit, following his visit to Italy last month. (이 대통령은 이날 브라질의 수도 브라질리아에서 주재한 수석보좌관회의에서 “유가 변동성이 당분간 이어질 가능성이 큰 만큼 국내 물가에 미칠 영향을 최소화하기 위한 선제적 노력을 빠르게 기울이고, 상황이 악화하면 추가 방안도 적극 검토해야 되겠다”며 이같이 말했다.)

The President stated, "The South American tour has now begun in earnest," and added, "Through this South American visit, we will further strengthen 'Global South diplomacy' and solidify our status and role as a key global nation." Following his state visit to Brazil, President Lee will also make official visits to Chile and Argentina. (이날 회의는 한국 청와대를 온라인으로 연결해 화상 회의로 진행됐다. 이 대통령이 순방 국가에서 화상으로 수석보좌관 회의를 진행한 건 지난달 이탈리아 국빈 방문에 이어 두 번째다.)

Regarding the 'San Francisco AI Declaration' announced in San Francisco, USA, on the 24th, President Lee said, "This declaration is a national statement of intent for our Republic of Korea to leap forward as an irreplaceable leader in the age of artificial intelligence," and added, "We will devote all our efforts to leading the world not only in AI but also in other advanced industries and cultural fields." (이 대통령은 “남미 순방이 이제 본격적으로 시작됐다”며 “이번 남미 순방을 통해 ‘글로벌 사우스 외교’를 더욱 강화하고 글로벌 핵심 국가로서의 위상과 역할을 더욱 단단하게 다지도록 하겠다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 브라질 국빈 방문에 이어, 칠레와 아르헨티나를 공식 방문한다.)

President Lee noted that July 27th marks the 'Armistice Agreement Day' and 'UN Forces Participation Day,' saying, "Over 70 years ago, South Korea, a small and weak country, preserved its freedom and democracy thanks to the noble sacrifices of overseas war veterans and the support of the international community." He added, "South Korea, which created the Miracle on the Han River, became the world's first country to transform from a recipient of aid to a donor. Now, as a key global power, South Korea stands at the forefront of the AI revolution, which will mark a new turning point for human civilization." (이 대통령은 지난 24일 미국 샌프란시스코에서 발표한 ‘샌프란시스코 AI 선언’에 대해선 “이번 선언은 우리 대한민국이 인공지능 시대를 이끄는 대체 불가한 선도자로 도약하겠다는 국가적인 출사표”라며 “인공지능을 넘어 여타 첨단 산업, 또 문화 분야에서도 세계를 선도하는 데 총력을 다할 것”이라고 했다.)

President Lee mentioned that exports have recently shown strong performance, and the growth rate for the second quarter, following the first quarter, "recorded nearly 4% at 3.7%." However, he warned, "If the fruits of growth are concentrated only on certain classes and sectors, economic imbalances will deepen, and the economy, which we've barely revived, will inevitably cool down again," adding, "Just as a room maintains its temperature longer when both the top and bottom of the ondol (floor heating) are evenly warm, the government must work to ensure the warmth of growth spreads widely for sustainable economic development." (이 대통령은 7월 27일이 ‘정전 협정 체결일’이자 ‘UN군 참전의 날’이라며 “70여 년 전 작고 힘없는 나라였던 대한민국은 해외 참전 용사들의 숭고한 헌신 그리고 국제 사회의 지원에 힘입어 자유와 민주주의를 지켜냈다”고 했다. 그러면서 “한강의 기적을 빚어낸 대한민국은 세계 최초로 도움받던 나라에서 도움 주는 나라로 바뀌었다”며 “글로벌 핵심 강국으로 성장한 대한민국은 이제 인류 문명의 새로운 전환점이 될 인공지능 혁명의 최첨단에 서 있다”고 했다.)

item.title: Election Commission Reports 72 Corrections to Voter Counts… Some Corrected 12 Hours Later (선관위, 투표자 수 수정 72건… 12시간 지나 고치기도)
item.description:
Election Commission Reports 72 Corrections to Voter Counts… Some Corrected 12 Hours Later (선관위, 투표자 수 수정 72건… 12시간 지나 고치기도)

On the day of the June 3 local elections, the National Election Commission (NEC) received 72 reports from subordinate election commissions regarding corrections made after entering voter counts into the system. In some cases, the voter count increased by over 6,000, or corrections were made up to 12 hours later. (6·3 지방선거 당일 중앙선거관리위원회가 산하 선관위로부터 투표자 수를 전산에 입력한 뒤 수정했다는 보고를 72건 받은 것으로 나타났다. 투표자 수가 6000명 넘게 늘어나거나, 12시간이 지나 수정된 경우도 있었다.)

According to data titled "Record of Voter Count Correction Reports by Time Period" obtained by People Power Party lawmaker Kim Eun-hye from the NEC on the 27th, on the local election day, the NEC received 72 correction reports from 56 out of 255 district, city, and county election commissions nationwide. (27일 국민의힘 김은혜 의원이 중앙선관위에서 받은 ‘시간대별 투표 수 수정 보고 이력’ 자료에 따르면, 지방선거날 중앙선관위는 전국 구·시·군선관위 255곳 가운데 56곳으로부터 72건의 수정 보고를 받았다.)

According to the comprehensive management guidelines for local elections, any corrections to entries in the election management system must include a detailed reason, and provincial election commissions must verify the reason and authorize the correction. (지방선거 종합관리지침에 따르면, 선거 관리 시스템에 입력한 내용을 수정하려면 그 사유를 구체적으로 기재해야 하고, 시·도선관위는 사유를 확인하고 수정을 허용해야 한다.)

However, many cases cited vague reasons that cannot be considered specific, such as "incorrect entry," "omission in entry," or "correction of voter count." (그러나 ‘오기재’ ‘기재 누락’ ‘투표자 수 수정’ 등 구체적인 사유라고 볼 수 없는 내용이 적힌 경우가 많았다.)

Incheon's Geomdan-gu initially reported a voter count of 54,665 as of 4 PM but later corrected it to 61,276—an increase of 6,611. The Geomdan Election Commission cited the reason as "aggregated and saved after final reporting per polling station, but the total voter count on election day differed." (인천 검단구는 오후 4시 기준 투표자 수가 5만4665명이라고 최초 보고했지만, 나중에 6만1276명으로 고쳤다. 6611명 늘어난 규모다. 검단선관위는 사유를 ‘투표소별 최종 보고 후 집계 및 저장하였으나 총 선거일 투표수가 상이함’이라고 적었다.)

Sangdang-gu, Cheongju-si, North Chungcheong Province, initially entered a voter count of 51,833 as of 5 PM but corrected it to 56,081—an increase of 4,248. The Sangdang Election Commission gave the reason as "the total voter count at 5 PM was 51,833, identical to 4 PM due to an input error, so it needs to be corrected to 56,081." (충북 청주시 상당구는 오후 5시 투표자 수를 5만1833명으로 입력했다가 5만6081명으로 고쳤다. 4248명 늘어난 것이다. 상당선관위는 사유를 ‘오후 5시 총 투표수가 5만1833명으로, 오후 4시와 동일하게 오입력돼 5만6081명으로 수정하려고 함’이라고 적었다.)

Hongseong-gun, South Chungcheong Province, noted that "the voter count reports for 4 PM and 5 PM on election day were reflected identically," and the count was corrected from 28,092 to 29,863. (충남 홍성군은 ‘오후 4시와 오후 5시 선거일 투표수 보고 숫자가 동일하게 반영됐다’고 적었고, 투표자 수가 2만8092명에서 2만9863명으로 수정됐다.)

Sacheon-si, South Gyeongsang Province, corrected the initially entered voter count of 15,634 at 12 PM to 19,631, while Goseong-gun, Gangwon Province, corrected the voter count entered at 11 AM as 4,392 to 5,639. (경남 사천시는 12시 1만5634명으로 최초 입력한 투표자 수를 1만9631명으로 고쳤고, 강원 고성군은 오전 11시 4392명으로 입력한 투표자 수를 5639명으로 고쳤다.)

There were also cases where corrections were made belatedly. Gunpo-si, Gyeonggi Province, corrected the voter count entered around 6:40 AM at 7 PM, and Jincheon-gun, North Chungcheong Province, corrected the voter count entered at 6:53 PM at 9 PM. (숫자를 뒤늦게 고친 경우도 있었다. 경기 군포시는 오전 6시 40분쯤 입력한 투표자 수를 오후 7시에 수정했고, 충북 진천군은 오후 6시 53분에 입력한 투표자 수를 오후 9시에 수정했다.)

Some corrections occurred multiple times. At the first polling station in Yonggang-dong, Gyeongju, North Gyeongsang Province, the voter count was adjusted from 2,162 to 2,161, then reverted to 2,162. (수정이 여러 차례 된 경우도 있었다. 경북 경주 용강동 제1투표소는 투표자 수를 2162명에서 2161명으로 1명 줄였다가, 2162명으로 되돌렸다.)

Kim Eun-hye stated, "The most basic and accurate voter turnout was determined and corrected in a haphazard manner," and argued, "It is hard to gauge how far this lax election management has spread." She emphasized, "A special counsel (investigation) must proceed thoroughly without any sanctuary." (김은혜 의원은 “가장 기초적이고 정확해야 할 투표율이 주먹구구식으로 파악되고 수정된 것”이라며 “해이한 선거 관리가 어디까지 번져 있었을지 쉽게 가늠하기 어렵다”고 주장했다. 그러면서 “특검(수사)이 성역 없이 강도 높게 진행돼야 한다”고 강조했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Leadership Urges Self-Expulsion for Kwon Young-jin After ‘Grabbing Floor Leader’s Collar’ (국힘 지도부, ‘원내대표 멱살’ 권영진에 “자진 탈당 권유”)
item.description:
People Power Party Leadership Urges Self-Expulsion for Kwon Young-jin After ‘Grabbing Floor Leader’s Collar’ (국힘 지도부, ‘원내대표 멱살’ 권영진에 “자진 탈당 권유”)

The Supreme Council of the People Power Party (PPP) agreed on the 27th that the highest level of disciplinary action, including expulsion, is necessary for lawmaker Kwon Young-jin, who grabbed the collar of floor leader Jung Jeom-sik in protest of the recent committee assignment results. The PPP leadership recommended that Kwon voluntarily withdraw from the party today, and if he does not accept, disciplinary proceedings will begin tomorrow. (국민의힘 최고위원회가 27일 최근 국회 상임위원회 배정 결과에 항의하며 정점식 원내대표의 멱살을 잡은 권영진 의원에 대해 ‘제명’을 포함한 최고 수준의 징계가 필요하다는 데 의견을 모았다. 국민의힘 지도부는 이날 권 의원에게 자진 탈당을 권유한 뒤 권 의원이 이를 받아들이지 않으면 내일 징계 절차를 개시할 예정이다.)

PPP senior spokesperson Park Sung-hoon met with reporters after a closed-door Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly in Yeouido, Seoul, this morning and stated, “Kwon’s act of grabbing the floor leader’s collar and using unspeakable verbal abuse is a wrongdoing that cannot be justified for any reason.” (국민의힘 박성훈 수석대변인은 이날 오전 서울 여의도 국회에서 열린 비공개 최고위원회 직후 기자들과 만나 “권 의원이 원내대표의 멱살을 잡고 입에 담을 수 없는 폭언을 행사한 부분은 어떤 이유로도 정당화할 수 없는 잘못된 행동”이라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

The PPP Supreme Council discussed whether to discipline Kwon over the ‘collar-grabbing’ controversy during today’s meeting. Park said, “The party leadership, without disagreement, reached a consensus that severe and strong punishment is necessary for this matter.” He added, “Specifically, the main opinions were to recommend voluntary withdrawal to Kwon, and if this is not accepted, to swiftly convene the ethics committee for the highest possible level of discipline.” “In particular, all attending leaders agreed that the highest level of punishment, including expulsion, is needed,” he explained. It is reported that floor leader Jung did not participate in this discussion as a party involved. <<> Floor leader Jung held a press conference just before the Supreme Council meeting and addressed the controversy, saying, “I will forget all past personal feelings and fulfill my duties as floor leader for the people’s lives and the normalization of South Korea.” This was interpreted as a stance of leniency toward Kwon. (국민의힘 최고위는 이날 회의에서 권 의원의 ‘멱살’ 논란과 관련해 징계 여부를 논의했다. 박 수석대변인은 “당 지도부는 이견 없이 이번 사안에 대해 엄중하고 강력한 처벌이 필요하다는 공감대를 이뤘다”고 했다. 이어 “구체적으로는 권 의원에 대해 자진 탈당을 권유하자는 의견과 이 의견이 받아들여지지 않을 경우 신속히 윤리위원회를 소집해 가능한 한 최고 수준의 징계가 필요하다는 의견이 주를 이뤘다”며 “특히 제명을 포함한 최고 수준의 징계가 필요하다는 데 참석한 지도부 모두 공감대를 이뤘다”고 설명했다. 해당 논의에서는 당사자인 정 원내대표는 참여하지 않은 것으로 알려졌다.)

He stated, “I am sorry for causing concern to the people and party members due to last week’s unfortunate incident.” (정 원내대표는 이날 최고위 직전 기자회견을 열고 관련 논란에 대해 “지난 사감(私感)을 모두 잊고 국민의 삶과 대한민국의 정상화를 위해서 원내대표로서의 책무를 다해나가겠다”고 말했다. 권 의원에 대한 관용의 입장을 밝힌 것으로 해석됐다.)

He added, “But last week’s incident is not just a personal issue, but an issue for the PPP as the leading conservative party.” “I believe this should serve as an opportunity to restore the dignity of conservatism and party discipline,” he said. (그는 “지난주 불미스러운 일로 인해 국민과 당원들께 심려를 끼쳐드려 송구하게 생각한다”며 이같이 밝혔다.)

Earlier, on the 23rd, Kwon, dissatisfied with the second half of the National Assembly’s committee assignments, visited floor leader Jung and grabbed his collar, also getting into a physical altercation with lawmaker Song Un-seok (former floor leader) who tried to intervene. Kwon was assigned as the secretary of the Public Administration and Security Committee, but it is known that he had wanted the secretary position on the Intelligence Committee, which receives more media exposure. (그러면서도 “지난주 일은 제 개인 문제가 아니라 보수 대표 정당인 국민의힘의 문제”라며 “이번 일이 보수의 품격과 당의 질서를 바로잡는 계기가 돼야 한다고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

As the controversy grew, Kwon posted an apology in the lawmakers’ Telegram group chat. He also stepped down from the position of secretary of the Public Administration and Security Committee and the previously slated role as chair of the PPP’s Daegu City Party. (앞서 권 의원은 지난 23일 국회 후반기 상임위원회 배정에 불만을 품고 정 원내대표를 찾아가 멱살을 잡고, 이 과정에서 말리는 송언석 의원(전 원내대표)과도 몸싸움을 벌였다. 권 의원은 행안위 간사로 배치됐으나 본인은 언론에 자주 노출되는 정보위원회 간사를 원한 것으로 알려졌다.)

item.title: UNC Commander: "Respect to 22 Contributing Nations That Protected Freedom and Security through Noble Sacrifice" (유엔사령관 “숭고한 희생으로 자유·안보 수호한 22개 참전국에 경의”)
item.description:
UNC Commander: "Respect to 22 Contributing Nations That Protected Freedom and Security through Noble Sacrifice" (유엔사령관 “숭고한 희생으로 자유·안보 수호한 22개 참전국에 경의” )

General Xavier Brunson, Commander of United Nations Command, U.S. Forces Korea, and ROK-U.S. Combined Forces Command, paid tribute to the 22 nations that contributed to the UN Command on the occasion of "UN Forces Participation Day" on the 27th. (제이비어 브런슨 유엔사령관 겸 주한미군사령관·한미연합사령관은 27일 ‘유엔군 참전의 날’을 맞아 “유엔사 22개 참전국에 경의를 표한다”고 했다.)

Commander Brunson stated on X (formerly Twitter) on this day, "Today marks the 73rd anniversary of the signing of the Korean War Armistice Agreement," adding, "While the Armistice Agreement is not a peace treaty, it has served as a framework that has maintained peace and stability on the Korean Peninsula over the past 73 years." (브런슨 사령관은 이날 X(옛 트위터)에 “오늘은 한국전쟁 정전협정 체결 73주년이 되는 날”이라며 “정전협정은 평화협정은 아니지만, 지난 73년 동안 한반도의 평화와 안정을 지켜내는 틀 역할을 해왔다”고 했다.)

He further expressed, "I offer deep respect to the 22 contributing nations of the United Nations Command, which defended the freedom and security of the Republic of Korea through their noble sacrifice," and described the veterans as "living bridges connecting the past battlefields to the peace we uphold today." Commander Brunson noted, "Their legacy reminds us that maintaining the Armistice Agreement requires steadfast commitment, unwavering vigilance, and reliable readiness," emphasizing that "there is no substitute for thorough readiness." (그러면서 “숭고한 희생으로 대한민국의 자유와 안보를 수호한 유엔군사령부 22개 참전국에 깊은 경의를 표표한다”며 참전용사 여러분은 지나간 전장과 우리가 오늘날 지켜내는 평화를 이어주는 살아있는 가교”라고 했다. 브런슨 사령관은 “이분들이 남긴 유산은 정전협정을 유지하기 위해 확고한 헌신, 흔들림 없는 경계, 그리고 신뢰할 수 있는 대비태세가 필요함을 일깨워 준다”며 “철저한 대비태세를 대체할 수 있는 것은 없다”고 했다.)

Two days after the outbreak of the Korean War due to North Korea's surprise invasion on June 27, 1950, the United Nations Security Council recommended the immediate cessation of hostilities by North Korea and withdrawal to north of the 38th parallel. Sixteen nations, including the United States, the United Kingdom, and Canada, dispatched combat troops, while six nations, including Sweden, Norway, and Germany, sent medical personnel. During the Korean War, which lasted until July 1953, over 40,000 UN soldiers were killed in action. (북한의 기습 남침으로 6·25전쟁이 발발하고 이틀이 지난 1950년 6월27일 유엔 안전보장이사회(안보리)는 북한에 적대 행위의 즉각적인 중단과 38선 이북으로의 철수를 권고했다. 미국·영국·캐나다 등 16국국이 전투 병력을, 스웨덴·노르웨이·독일 등 6국이 의료진을 한국에 파견했다. 1953년 7월까지 지속된 6·25전쟁 기간 4만명 넘는 유엔군 장병이 전사했다.)

The government designated the armistice date (July 27, 1953) as the national commemorative day "UN Forces Participation Day" in 2013. This is aimed at re-examining the historical significance of the UN forces' participation and honoring the sacrifices and contributions of the veterans. (정부는 2013년 정전협정일(1953년 7월 27일)을 국가기념일인 ‘유엔군 참전의 날’로 정했다. 유엔군 참전의 역사적 의의를 재조명하고 참전용사의 희생과 공헌을 기린다는 취지다.)

The Ministry of Patriots and Veterans Affairs will host a "Thanksgiving Dinner for UN Participating Nations" on the evening of the 27th at the Grand Hyatt Seoul Hotel, with all 22 contributing nations in attendance. (국가보훈부는 27일 저녁 서울 그랜드 하얏트 호텔에서 22개 참전국 전원이 참석하는 ‘유엔참전국 감사 만찬’을 개최한다.)

item.title: Kim Jong Un Visits 'Martyrs' Cemetery' and Chinese Military Cemetery on Korean War Armistice Day, Claims 'Great Victory' (김정은, 6·25 정전일 맞아 ‘열사릉’·중국군 묘역 참배… “위대한 승리” 주장)
item.description:
Kim Jong Un Visits 'Martyrs' Cemetery' and Chinese Military Cemetery on Korean War Armistice Day, Claims 'Great Victory' (김정은, 6·25 정전일 맞아 ‘열사릉’·중국군 묘역 참배… “위대한 승리” 주장)

North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visited the cemeteries of North Korean and Chinese soldiers on the 73rd anniversary of the Korean War Armistice Agreement, highlighting friendly relations with China. <<> The Korean Central News Agency reported on the 27th that Kim Jong Un visited the Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs' Cemetery in Pyongyang, the Revolutionary Martyrs' Cemetery on Taesongsan Mountain, and the Chinese People's Volunteer Army Martyrs' Cemetery in Hoechang County, South Pyongyang Province the previous day. <<> The Fatherland Liberation War Martyrs' Cemetery is the burial ground for North Korean soldiers who fought in the Korean War. The news agency stated, "Comrade Kim Jong Un warmly met with war veterans and sincerely wished for their health and longevity." It added, "Comrade Kim Jong Un paid tribute by laying flowers at the memorial symbol 'Spirit of Heroes,' praying for the eternal life of the martyrs who, at the dawn of the nation's founding, gallantly elevated the dignity of heroic Korea with their precious blood and solemnly inscribed the first page of national defense." <<> Kim Jong Un said, "Although many long years have passed since the day the war's flames ceased, the great victory—where the young, nascent Korea, in its infancy, resolutely defended not only the nation's dignity and sovereignty but also world peace and security in an unequal, fierce struggle against the imperialist monster, the U.S., and its followers—shines as the most miraculous triumph and an immortal heroic epic, unmatched in any chapter of human war history." <<> North Korea claims it achieved victory in the Korean War. It commemorates the date of the Armistice Agreement as 'Fatherland Liberation War Victory Day.' <<> According to photos released by the news agency, Kim Jong Un's daughter Ju Ae and wife Ri Sol Ju accompanied him. Ju Ae's attendance at an official event marks her first appearance in 52 days since observing the navigation test of the Kang Gon Ho on June 4. <<> While visiting the Revolutionary Martyrs' Cemetery on Taesongsan Mountain—where figures credited with establishing the North Korean regime and independence activists are buried—Kim Jong Un also referred to the Korean War as "the miracle of July 27, achieved by the ordinary soldiers and people of this land through ardent love and indomitable strength." He added, "When we forever remember the valuable spirit of self-respect, unmatched tenacity, and noble sacrifice of the victorious generation who pioneered the republic's heroic history with blood, and remain faithful to their will and resolve, our cause of national prosperity and strength will advance triumphantly." <<> Kim Jong Un also visited the Chinese People's Volunteer Army Martyrs' Cemetery, which contains the graves of fallen soldiers from the general headquarters who fought on North Korea's side in the Korean War. Among the 134 remains buried there is that of Mao Anying, son of former Chinese Chairman Mao Zedong. <<> The news agency reported, "Comrade Kim Jong Un visited the grave of Comrade Mao Anying, laid a flower, and paid his respects." It added, "The noble spirit and sacrificial devotion of the Chinese People's Volunteer Army soldiers, who aided our people's just war with their blood during the most fateful and difficult alliance, are vividly embedded in the victory our people achieved and shine as the cornerstone of North Korea-China friendship centered on socialism." <<> Last year, when relations between North Korea and China were strained, the news agency briefly reported that Kim Jong Un had visited the Friendship Tower honoring the Chinese military. (김정은 북한 국무위원장이 6·25전쟁 정전협정 체결 73주년을 맞아 북한군·중국군 묘역을 참배하고, 중국과의 친선 관계를 부각시켰다.)

item.title: Kim Yong-beom: "If Holding Taxes Are Strengthened, We Will Consider Exit Strategies for Multiple Homeowners" (김용범 “보유세 강화 땐 다주택자 퇴로 방안 검토”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-beom: "If Holding Taxes Are Strengthened, We Will Consider Exit Strategies for Multiple Homeowners" (김용범 “보유세 강화 땐 다주택자 퇴로 방안 검토”)

Kim Yong-beom, the presidential chief of staff for policy, stated on the 27th regarding real estate tax reforms that the government is reviewing measures such as providing exit routes for multiple homeowners to list their properties if holding taxes are strengthened. (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 27일 부동산 세제 개편과 관련해 보유세 강화시 다주택자가 매물을 내놓을 수 있도록 퇴로를 열어주는 방안 등을 검토하고 있다고 밝혔다.)

On this day, Director Kim said on CBS Radio's "Park Seong-tae's News Show," "There were various opinions on how to strengthen holding taxes and what the criteria for ultra-high-priced homes should be," adding, "We are gradually reaching a consensus on the criteria for ultra-high-priced homes." (김 실장은 이날 CBS라디오 ‘박성태의 뉴스쇼’에서 “보유세를 어떤 방식으로 강화할 것인지, 초고가 주택의 기준은 무엇인지에 대해 다양한 의견이 있었다”며 “초고가 주택 기준에 대해 나름대로 의견을 모아가고 있다”고 했다.)

He further introduced, "Regarding capital gains tax, constructive opinions have been raised, such as setting a limit on the long-term holding special deduction, providing exit routes for multiple homeowners to put their properties on the market when holding taxes are strengthened, and easing the tax burden for those moving to rural areas after retirement." (이어 “양도세의 경우도 장기보유 특별공제(장특공제)의 한도를 설정하는 것, 또 다주택자의 경우 보유세가 강화됐을 때 매물을 내놓을 수 있도록 퇴로를 열어주는 것, 은퇴 후 지방으로 이주하는 분들의 세 부담을 덜어주는 것 등 여러 건설적인 의견이 나왔다”고 소개했다.)

On the supply side, he said, "Even the previously announced policies take a long time, from site development to completion," adding, "I think the president will hold a comprehensive review meeting to discuss ways to expedite all procedures." (공급과 관련해서는 “기왕에 발표했던 정책도 택지 조성부터 시간이 오래 걸린다”며 “그래서 대통령이 모든 절차를 신속하게 하는 방안을 전반적으로 다 점검하는 토론회도 한 번 하실 것 같다”고 했다.)

Ha Jun-kyung, the presidential senior secretary for economic growth, also said on SBS Radio's "Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show" regarding loan regulations, "If there are unreasonable aspects, they should naturally be corrected," and "The basic stance is to re-examine loans that stimulate supply rather than loans that increase demand." He added, "If there are cases where something was institutionally guaranteed but suddenly becomes unavailable, or banks abruptly tighten lending, there is a need to prepare escape routes on a targeted basis." (하준경 청와대 경제성장수석도 이날 SBS 라디오 ‘김태현의 정치쇼’에서 대출 규제와 관련해 “불합리한 부분이 있으면 당연히 고쳐야 한다”며 “기본적으로 수요를 높이는 종류의 대출보다는 공급을 활성화하는 대출은 다시 한번 살펴보자는 기조”라고 했다. 이어 “제도적으로 보장돼 있었는데 갑자기 안 된다거나, 은행이 갑자기 (대출을) 조인다거나 하는 경우는 핀셋형으로 탈출구를 마련할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding measures to stabilize the rental market, he stated, "There are preparations for parts that can be supplied quickly in the short term," and "An announcement will be made soon." (전월세 안정화 대책과 관련해선 “단기적으로 공급이 빨리 될 수 있는 부분에 대해서도 준비를 하는 것들이 있다”며 “조만간 발표가 될 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk to Assume Role as Director of Innovation Policy Research Institute for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party (조국, 조국혁신당 연구원장 맡는다)
item.description:
Cho Kuk to Assume Role as Director of Innovation Policy Research Institute for the Cho Kuk Innovation Party (조국, 조국혁신당 연구원장 맡는다)

Shin Jang-sik, the newly appointed leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, has nominated former party leader Cho Kuk as the director of the Innovation Policy Research Institute. This move aims to strengthen the party’s policy capabilities for its key initiative, "The Cho Kuk Innovation Party Fights Inequality." (조국혁신당 신장식 신임 대표는 당의 핵심 과제인 ‘불평등과 싸우는 조국혁신당’의 정책적 역량 강화를 위해 조국 전 대표를 혁신정책연구원장으로 지명했다.)

Earlier, former leader Cho Kuk stated in a video message of encouragement for the National Party Members’ Convention held on the 25th, "I hope the Cho Kuk Innovation Party will push forward with the path of a 'party that overcomes inequality' and firmly establish and practice 'progressive futurism.'" (앞서 조 전 대표는 지난 25일 열린 전국당원대회 격려 영상을 통해 “조국혁신당이 ‘불평등을 이기는 정당’의 길로 매진하며, ‘진보적 미래주의’를 굳건히 다지고 실천해 나가길 바란다”고 했었다.)

The Cho Kuk Innovation Party announced, "With this nomination, former leader Cho Kuk will focus on designing and developing specific policy alternatives such as the 'Golden Rule of Social Investment' as the director of the Innovation Policy Research Institute. It is understood that he plans to strengthen the party's mid- to long-term vision and solidify its direction." (조국혁신당은 “이번 지명에 따라 조 전 대표는 혁신정책연구원장으로서 ‘사회투자 골든 룰’ 등 구체적인 정책 대안을 설계하고 발전시키는 데 주력할 것으로 보인다. 당의 중장기적 비전을 강화해 당의 지향점을 확고히 다질 계획인 것으로 알려졌다”고 밝혔다.)

Former leader Cho Kuk resigned from his position as party leader after losing the June 3 by-election for the Pyeongtaek-eul constituency in Gyeonggi Province. The Cho Kuk Innovation Party held a convention on the 25th and elected Shin Jang-sik as its new leader. (조 전 대표는 지난 6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거에서 낙선한 뒤 대표직에서 사퇴했다. 조국혁신당은 지난 25일 전당대회를 열고 신장식 대표를 선출했다.)

On the same day, Shin held the party’s first open meeting as leader, the Supreme Council meeting, at the National Assembly. He stated, "If all cases are transferred to the prosecution, the prosecution organization should either remain as is or be expanded. A large organization will become a foundation for the future revival of the prosecution." (신 대표는 이날 취임 후 첫 공개회의인 당 최고위원회의를 국회에서 열고 “모든 사건이 송치되면 검찰 조직을 그대로 두거나 확대해야 한다. 거대 조직은 훗날 검찰 부활을 도모할 발판이 될 것”이라고 했다.)

He also mentioned that the party had established a "National Situation Room for Completing Prosecution Reform" at the National Assembly that day. "The situation room will watch with the eyes of the people, with eagle eyes, to see whether provisions granting investigative powers to the prosecution are slyly inserted in the Legislation and Judiciary Committee, or whether strange amendments are proposed at the National Assembly plenary session, making prosecution reform fizzle out," he said. (그는 이날 국회에 ‘검찰개혁 완수 국민상황실’을 설치했다고 언급하고 “상황실에서 검찰에 수사권을 주는 조항이 법사위에서 은근슬쩍 들어가는지, 국회 본회의에 희한한 수정안이 제시돼 검찰 개혁이 흐지부지되는지를 국민의 눈으로, 매의 눈으로 감시하겠다”고 했다.)

New Supreme Council member Hwang Hyun-sun targeted contenders for the leadership of the Democratic Party of Korea, who are currently in a debate over merging with the Innovation Party. He remarked, "Don't drink the soup before it's even offered. The person offering the cake isn’t even thinking about it." (황현선 신임 최고위원은 회의에서 혁신당과의 합당 문제를 두고 논쟁을 벌이고 있는 더불어민주당 당권 주자들을 겨냥해 “떡 줄 사람은 생각도 없는데 김칫국부터 마시지 마십시오”라고 했다.)

Hwang, a Supreme Council member, stated, "The Cho Kuk Innovation Party is not a side dish to be placed on or taken off the table according to the Democratic Party’s taste. Using the Innovation Party will also negatively affect the cooperative relationship between the two parties and the success of the Lee Jae-myung government." (황 최고위원은 “조국혁신당은 민주당의 입맛에 따라 밥상에 올렸다 내리는 반찬이 아니다”라며 “혁신당을 이용하는 행위는 양당의 협력관계와 이재명 정부의 성공에도 악영향을 미칠 것”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Justice Minister Jeong Seong-ho: "Prosecution Reform in Final Stages... Resigned Due to Poor Health" (정성호 법무 “검찰 개혁 마무리 단계… 건강도 좋지 않아 사의”)
item.description:
Justice Minister Jeong Seong-ho: "Prosecution Reform in Final Stages... Resigned Due to Poor Health" (정성호 법무 “검찰 개혁 마무리 단계… 건강도 좋지 않아 사의”)

Justice Minister Jeong Seong-ho stated on the 27th that the "prosecution reform" is mostly complete, and that due to his own poor health, he expressed his intention to resign to President Lee Jae-myung. (정성호 법무부 장관이 ‘검찰 개혁’이 대부분 끝났고 자기 건강이 좋지 않아서 이재명 대통령에게 사의를 표명한 것이라고 27일 밝혔다.)

Attending a full session of the Legislation and Judiciary Committee at the National Assembly that morning, Minister Jeong was asked, "Will you directly express your intention to resign when President Lee returns?" and responded, "The news reports about my resignation were quite unexpected." (정 장관은 이날 오전 국회에서 열린 법제사법위원회 전체회의에 출석해 ‘이재명 대통령이 귀국하면 직접 사의를 표명할 것이냐’는 질의를 받고 “언론에 제 거취에 관한 기사가 나온 것은 상당히 뜻밖”이라고 했다.)

Minister Jeong said, "When I took office as minister, the biggest task was the prosecution reform, and now it has somewhat gotten on track." He added, "Because the prosecution had excessively abused its power in the past, lawmakers accepted the public's will and declared the major principle of separating investigation and prosecution, and as a result, prosecutors' investigative powers were ultimately stripped away." He continued, "As an institutional mechanism, the policy to abolish the prosecution service and transition to a Public Prosecutors' Office has already been established, and it only needs to launch on October 1st." (정 장관은 “장관에 취임할 때 가장 큰 과제는 검찰 개혁 문제였는데, 이제 어느 정도 궤도에 올라 있다”고 했다. 그는 “검찰이 과거에 권한을 너무 오·남용했기 때문에 의원들이 국민적 뜻을 받아서 수사·기소 분리의 대원칙을 선언했고, 그 결과로 검사 수사권을 최종 박탈했다”며 “그 제도적 장치로 이미 (검찰청을 폐지하고) 공소청화하는 정책이 만들어졌고, 10월 1일 출범만 하면 된다”고 했다.)

Minister Jeong noted, "I believe that about 95% of the prosecution reform has been achieved, but recently there is the issue of supplementary investigative powers." On this, Minister Jeong said, "The government has already stated, with Prime Minister Kim Min-seok declaring that the abolition of supplementary investigative powers is a basic principle, and I have expressed the position that 'I hope this will be well supplemented so that the public is not anxious and victim protection is not neglected.'" (정 장관은 “저는 그로써 검찰 개혁이 한 95%는 달성됐다고 보는데, 최근에 보완수사권 문제가 있다”고 했다. 이에 대해 정 장관은 “이미 정부에서는 김민석 국무총리가 보완수사권 폐지가 기본 원칙이라고 선언했고, 저는 ‘국민들이 불안하지 않게, 피해자 보호에 소홀하지 않게 잘 보완했으면 좋겠다’는 입장을 밝혔다”고 했다.)

Minister Jeong stated, "In the big picture, since the prosecution reform is mostly completed, I had thought even before Prime Minister Kim announced the abolition of supplementary investigative powers that new wine should be put into new wineskins." (정 장관은 “저는 큰 틀에 있어서 검찰 개혁이 대부분 완료됐기 때문에, 이제 새 술은 새 부대에 담아야 한다는 생각을 김 총리가 보완수사권 폐지를 발표하기 전부터 해 왔다”고 했다.)

He also said, "My current health condition is not good. I've had surgery and suffer from quite severe sleep disorders." He added, "Considering these aspects, (I expressed my intention to resign)." (또 “지금 건강 상태가 좋지 않다. 수술도 했고 상당히 심각한 수면 장애가 있다”며 “그런 측면을 고려해서 (사의를 표명한 것)”이라고 했다.)

Before the meeting began that day, Minister Jeong met with reporters and was asked, "Is your resignation because the Democratic Party of Korea has set the abolition of supplementary investigative powers as party policy?" In response, Minister Jeong avoided answering, saying, "The President is abroad working for the national interest, so it is not appropriate to talk about such matters." (정 장관은 이날 회의 시작 전 기자들과 만나 ‘사의 표명은 더불어민주당이 보완수사권 폐지를 당론으로 정했기 때문인가’라는 질문을 받았다. 이에 대해 정 장관은 “대통령이 외국에 국익을 위해 일하러 갔는데 그런 이야기를 하면 적절하지 않다”며 답을 피했다.)

item.title: Opposition Party's National Convention Voter List Finalized… 17,667 Delegates, 1.52 Million Rights-Bearing Members (與 전당대회 선거인명부 확정… 대의원 1만7667명, 권리당원 152만명)
item.description:
Opposition Party's National Convention Voter List Finalized… 17,667 Delegates, 1.52 Million Rights-Bearing Members (與 전당대회 선거인명부 확정… 대의원 1만7667명, 권리당원 152만명)

The Democratic Party of Korea finalized its voter list for the August 17 national convention on the 27th, announcing that there are 17,667 delegates and 1,527,261 rights-bearing members. (더불어민주당이 27일 8·17 전당대회 선거인 명부를 확정하고, 대의원이 1만7667명, 권리당원이 152만7261명이라고 밝혔다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang Jun-hyun of the Democratic Party met with reporters after the party's Supreme Council meeting at the National Assembly on the morning of that day and stated, "We have reviewed and finalized the voter list," adding this information. (민주당 강준현 수석대변인은 이날 오전 국회에서 당 최고위원회의가 끝난 뒤 기자들과 만나 “선거인 명부를 확정 의결했다”며 이같이 전했다.)

Senior Spokesperson Kang explained that the number of rights-bearing members is the net figure after excluding duplicates in addresses, resident registration numbers, or bank account numbers. (강 수석대변인은 권리당원 숫자에 대해 주소지나 주민등록번호, 계좌번호가 중복되는 경우를 제거한 순인원이라고 설명했다.)

The finalized voter list will be used in the Democratic Party's national convention precinct-level primaries. The party will begin the precinct-level primaries on the 1st of next month starting from South Chungcheong, North Chungcheong, Daejeon, and Sejong, and will conclude on the 16th with Gyeonggi and Seoul. The winners for the party leader and Supreme Council members will be announced on the 17th. (이번에 확정된 선거인 명부는 민주당 전당대회 순회 경선에서 사용된다. 민주당은 다음 달 1일 충남과 충북, 대전·세종을 시작으로 순회 경선을 시작하고, 16일 경기·서울을 끝으로 마무리한다. 당대표·최고위원 당선자는 17일 발표한다.)

item.title: Justice Minister Chung Seong-ho Said to Have Offered Resignation... Presidential Office: "Not True" (정성호 법무는 사의표명 했다는데...靑 “사실 아니다”)
item.description:
Justice Minister Chung Seong-ho Said to Have Offered Resignation... Presidential Office: "Not True" (정성호 법무는 사의표명 했다는데...靑 “사실 아니다”)

<<>> Although Justice Minister Chung Seong-ho was reported to have recently expressed his intention to resign, a Blue House official told reporters on the 26th (local time) in Brazil, where President Lee Jae-myung is on a state visit, that "the Justice Minister's resignation offer is not true." In response to questions about Minister Chung's resignation, the official stated, "No official resignation offer from Minister Chung has been confirmed." ()

President Lee presided over a video meeting of senior secretaries that day in Brasília, the capital of Brazil. The Blue House said there was no discussion regarding Minister Chung's future during that meeting. (정성호 법무부 장관이 최근 사의를 표명한 것으로 전해졌지만, 청와대 관계자는 26일(현지 시각) 이재명 대통령이 국빈 방문 중인 브라질 현지에서 기자들과 만나 “법무부 장관의 사의 표명은 사실이 아니다”라고 했다. 이 관계자는 정 장관의 사의 표명 관련 질문에 “정 장관의 공식적인 사의 표명은 확인된 바 없다”며 이같이 말했다.)

Minister Chung is said to have offered his resignation amid the Democratic Party of Korea's push to pass a bill abolishing the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority. Minister Chung has repeatedly expressed his opposition to the complete abolition of this supplementary investigation authority. (이 대통령은 이날 브라질 수도 브라질리아에서 화상 수석보좌관회의를 주재했다. 청와대는 이날 회의에서 정 장관의 거취와 관련한 논의는 없었다고 했다.)

On the 25th, Minister Chung told this newspaper, "I didn't speak directly to the president, but I have conveyed my intention to resign through Blue House aides before," adding, "I have nothing more to do and no will to do it." When asked about his resignation offer during a plenary session of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee on the 27th, Minister Chung said, "Since most of the prosecution reforms in the broad framework have been completed, I thought that new wine should be put into new wineskins even before the Democratic Party announced the abolition of the supplementary investigation authority," and "My health is not good. I had surgery and have a severe sleep disorder. Considering these aspects, I made my resignation known." (정 장관은 최근 더불어민주당이 검찰의 보완 수사권을 폐지하는 법안 통과를 밀어붙이는 국면에서 사의를 표명한 것으로 전해졌다. 정 장관은 보완 수사권 완전 폐지에 반대 입장을 거듭 밝혀왔다.)

However, the Blue House denied Minister Chung's resignation offer on this day. It also maintained its existing position that the abolition of the prosecution's supplementary investigation authority was "a matter for the National Assembly to decide." Regarding the timing of a cabinet reshuffle, it said, "There is no set schedule or anticipated situation." (정 장관은 지난 25일 본지에 “대통령에게 직접 이야기하지는 않았지만 사퇴 의지는 이전부터 청와대 참모들을 통해 전달했다”며 “저는 더 할 일도 없고 의지도 없다”고 했다. 정 장관은 27일 국회 법제사법위 전체회의에 출석해서도 사의 표명에 관한 질문이 나오자 “큰 틀에 있어서 검찰 개혁이 대부분 완료됐기 때문에, 이제 새 술은 새 부대에 담아야 한다는 생각을 (민주당이) 보완 수사권 폐지를 발표하기 전부터 해 왔다”며 “건강 상태가 좋지 않다. 수술도 했고 상당히 심각한 수면 장애가 있다. 그런 측면을 고려해서 (사의를 밝힌 것)”이라고 했다.)

Regarding the Blue House's denial that Minister Chung offered to resign, some within the ruling party analyze that this is due to the upcoming Democratic Party national convention next month. The reasoning is that acknowledging Minister Chung's resignation would require the Blue House to take a position on whether to abolish the supplementary investigation authority, which triggered the matter. If the Blue House expressed a negative stance on abolishing the authority, it could provoke backlash from hardline supporters and also affect the race for party leadership. (하지만 청와대는 이날 정 장관의 사의 표명을 부인했다. 검찰 보완 수사권 폐지에 대해서도 ‘국회에서 판단해서 결정할 일’이라는 기존 입장에 변화가 없다고 했다. 개각 시점에 대해서도 “정해진 일정이나 예측된 상황이 없다”고 했다.)

item.title: Drinking Wine but Taking a Shot with Soju? Cho Kuk: "Trivial Article... I Drank Both Wine and Soju" (와인 마시다 소주로 인증샷? 조국 “같잖은 기사… 와인·소주 다 마셨다”)
item.description:
Drinking Wine but Taking a Shot with Soju? Cho Kuk: "Trivial Article... I Drank Both Wine and Soju" (와인 마시다 소주로 인증샷? 조국 “같잖은 기사… 와인·소주 다 마셨다”)

Former leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, Cho Kuk, refuted claims that he staged a "certification shot" with a soju glass after drinking wine. <<> On the morning of the 24th, former leader Cho posted on Facebook, "I shared a drink with actor Lee Gwan-hoon, who visited to support me in the Pyeongtaek by-election," along with a photo. In the picture, Cho and Lee are clinking soju glasses. <<> Some media outlets reported, "There were suspicions that Cho intentionally included soju in the certification photo." They claimed, "In the corner of the photo, a bottle of wine with its cap open and part of a white wine glass were visible. The soju bottle had its lid closed, and the drink inside hardly seemed to have decreased." <<> In response, former leader Cho posted on Facebook on the afternoon of the 26th, saying, "They've written another bizarre article," adding, "It's an article that shows an intent to stigmatize me negatively; it's pathetic and trivial." <<> Cho stated, "On that day, a total of four people gathered, had draft beer to start, and then drank soju according to personal preference or the Spanish white wine that actor Lee brought," adding, "I drank both. If you look at the photo, you'll see the empty draft beer glass, soju bottle, soju glass, wine bottle, and wine glass all clearly." <<> Cho continued, "In our society, wine has long become a popular drink," and "I am also a wine enthusiast, so there's no reason to hide that I drank wine." <<> He said, "I wish the journalist well, who, even in the scorching heat, fixates on my every move and is busy finding flaws," adding, "Seeing these things, it seems like being a journalist is quite easy." <<> Former leader Cho added, "This time too, I ate both meat and soybean paste stew ^^." This appears to reference the controversy from last August when, after being released from prison, he dined with family at a hanwoo (Korean beef) restaurant and released a video showing only the soybean paste stew. At the time, Cho responded, "In the eyes of a pig, only pigs are seen." (조국 전 조국혁신당 대표가 와인을 마셔 놓고 소주잔으로 ‘인증샷’을 연출했다는 의혹 제기에 반박했다.)

item.title: People Power Party Ethics Committee "Initiates Disciplinary Procedures Against Reps. Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh" (국힘 윤리위 “조경태·권영진·진종오 의원 징계 절차 개시”)
item.description:
People Power Party Ethics Committee "Initiates Disciplinary Procedures Against Reps. Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh" (국힘 윤리위 “조경태·권영진·진종오 의원 징계 절차 개시”)

The People Power Party's Ethics Committee announced on the 27th that it has initiated disciplinary procedures against Reps. Cho Kyung-tae (6th term, Saha-gu, Busan), Kwon Young-jin (2nd term, Dalseo-gu, Daegu), and Jin Jong-oh (1st term, proportional representation). The Ethics Committee reviewed disciplinary motions submitted before and after the June 3 local elections at its meeting that day and passed this resolution. (국민의힘 윤리위원회가 27일 조경태(6선·부산 사하을), 권영진(재선·대구 달서병), 진종오(초선·비례대표) 의원에 대한 징계 절차를 개시한다고 밝혔다. 윤리위는 이날 회의에서 6·3 지방선거 전후로 접수된 징계안을 심의하고 이같이 의결했다.)

The Ethics Committee did not provide a separate explanation for the background of initiating disciplinary action against these lawmakers. However, Rep. Cho Kyung-tae had previously been referred to the Ethics Committee for allegedly asking Democratic Party lawmakers to ensure the defeat of People Power Party Rep. Park Deok-heum during the process of electing the National Assembly Deputy Speaker. (윤리위는 이들 의원에 대한 징계를 개시하는 배경에 대해서는 따로 설명하지 않았다. 다만 조경태 의원은 앞서 국회부의장 선출과정에서 더불어민주당 의원들에게 국민의힘 박덕흠 의원의 낙선을 요구했다는 이유로 윤리위에 제소된 바 있다.)

In the case of Rep. Kwon Young-jin, he was subjected to disciplinary action after grabbing the collar of floor leader Rep. Jung Jeom-sik while protesting the recent allocation of National Assembly standing committees. Rep. Jin Jong-oh was referred to the Ethics Committee for allegedly supporting independent candidate Rep. Han Dong-hoon in the June 3 by-election for the Buk-gu, Busan district. (권영진 의원의 경우 최근 국회 상임위원회 배정 과정에 항의하면서 정점식 원내대표의 멱살을 잡아채 징계 대상에 올랐다. 진종오 의원은 6·3 국회의원 부산 북갑 보궐선거에서 무소속 한동훈 의원을 지원했다는 이유로 윤리위에 제소됐다.)

Reps. Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh are all classified as non-mainstream figures within the party. Rep. Cho publicly called for the resignation of Party Leader Jang after the local elections, and Rep. Kwon is active in the party's young-turk faction gathering, "Alternatives and Future." Rep. Jin is categorized as being aligned with the pro-Han faction (affiliated with Han Dong-hoon). (조경태·권영진·진종오 의원은 모두 당내에서 비주류로 분류된다. 조 의원은 지방선거 이후 장 대표의 사퇴를 공개요구했고, 권 의원도 당내 소장파 의원 모임 ‘대안과 미래’에서 활동하고 있다. 진 의원은 친한계(한동훈계)로 분류된다.)

The meeting that day is reported to have proceeded with only three out of five total members present, including Ethics Committee Chairman Yoon Min-woo. The People Power Party's Ethics Committee stipulates that "decisions can be made with a majority attendance of incumbent members and a majority vote in favor." (이날 회의는 윤민우 윤리위원장을 포함해서 전체 5명 가운데 3명만 참석한 상태로 진행된 것으로 전해졌다. 국민의힘 윤리위는 “재적위원 과반수 출석, 과반수 찬성으로 의결이 가능하다”고 규정하고 있다.)

The People Power Party Ethics Committee previously operated with seven members. However, as internal conflicts within the Ethics Committee deepened, two ethics committee members recently resigned one after another, resulting in a "five-member Ethics Committee." (국민의힘 윤리위는 종전까지 7인 체제였다. 그러나 윤리위 내부갈등이 깊어지면서 두 명의 윤리위원이 최근 잇따라 사퇴하면서 ‘5인 윤리위’가 됐다.)

Amid this situation, Ethics Committee Vice Chairman Woo Jong-hwan and Ethics Committee member Hwang Kyung-sun, who oppose hasty disciplinary actions, did not attend the meeting that day. Consequently, the decision to initiate disciplinary proceedings against Reps. Cho Kyung-tae, Kwon Young-jin, and Jin Jong-oh was made by only three ethics committee members, including Chairman Yoon Min-woo. (이런 가운데 이날 회의에는 무리한 징계에 반대하는 우종환 윤리위 부위원장, 황경선 윤리위원이 불참했다. 이에 따라 윤민우 위원장을 포함한 3명의 윤리위원으로만 조경태·권영진·진종오 의원에 대한 징계 개시 결정을 내린 것이다.)

Prior to this decision, open opposition to the disciplinary motion had been raised within the People Power Party's Ethics Committee. (이 같은 결정에 앞서 국민의힘 윤리위 내부에선 징계안에 대한 공개적인 반발이 제기됐다.)

Ethics Committee Vice Chairman Woo Jong-hwan and Ethics Committee member Hwang Kyung-sun issued a statement that day, saying, "Chairman Yoon Min-woo and Ethics Committee member Jung Kyung-wook should publicly apologize for their announcement of disciplinary standards that seem like an act of loyalty pledge," adding, "We will not turn a blind eye to using the independent Ethics Committee as a personal political ladder." This suggests that some ethics committee members, centered around Chairman Yoon, are pushing forward disciplinary motions to protect the authority of Party Leader Jang. (우종환 윤리위 부위원장과 황경선 윤리위원은 이날 성명서를 내고 “윤민우 위원장과 정경욱 윤리위원은 충성 맹세용 징계 기준안 발표에 대해 공개 사과하라”며 “독립 기구인 윤리위를 개인의 정치적 사다리로 이용하는 것을 좌시하지 않을 것”이라고 했다. 윤 위원장을 중심으로 일부 윤리위원이 장 대표 심기 경호 차원에서 징계안을 밀어붙이고 있다는 취지다.)

Indeed, Party Leader Jang has been repeatedly arguing, "Strict measures must be taken against acts that harm the party, such as supporting independent candidates or candidates from other parties in elections." (실제 장 대표는 연일 “선거에서 무소속 후보나 다른 당 후보를 지원한 해당(害黨) 행위에 대해 엄정한 조치가 있어야 한다”고 주장하고 있다.)

A senior People Power Party lawmaker said, "The Ethics Committee, an independent body, is now carrying out disciplinary actions ordered by the party leader," adding, "The possibility that the Ethics Committee's decision could be overturned again by the courts cannot be ruled out." (국민의힘 한 중진의원은 “독립기구인 윤리위에서 당대표 하명(下命) 징계가 이뤄지고 있다”며 “윤리위 결정이 또다시 법원에서 뒤집힐 가능성도 배제할 수 없다”고 말했다.)
